#+TITLE: Examples

* Inputs

Instance to deploy

#+name: input-instance
#+caption: The instance, from the DB
: aly-andina

#+name: input-port
: 8080

#+name: input-notes
#+begin_example
  first line
  second line

* Output

A result, not an input:

#+RESULTS: server
: aly-2602-suite

A block whose name looks like an input is a runnable:

#+name: input-container
#+begin_src sh :results output
echo container
#+end_src

Colons inside a block are text:

#+begin_src sh
: not-an-example
#+end_src
